clue.text: Fleet needs to caulk seams rounding cape

indicators.note: rounding means going around, so the caulking word goes around the cape letter

parts.note: to pay a ship's seams is to coat them with pitch to make them watertight
C is the map abbreviation for cape

explanation.surface: A naval fleet must have its hulls caulked as it sails round a headland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fleet' looks like a noun for ships but is the adjective meaning fast; PAY is a nautical verb for sealing seams with pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: Fleet as an adjective means swift, a synonym of quick-moving.

clue.text: After hunting, I got in carriage

parts.note: post- is the Latin prefix meaning after

indicators.note: got in says the single letter has been put inside the hunting word

parts.note: a chase is a hunt

explanation.surface: Once the hunt was over, the speaker climbed into a coach.
explanation.definitionFit: A post-chaise is a horse-drawn travelling carriage hired from stage to stage.

clue.text: Sailor was boastful on island

parts.note: crew is an old past tense of crow, to boast
the Isle of Man lies in the Irish Sea

explanation.surface: A seaman bragged about himself while on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: A crewman is a member of a ship's company, a type of sailor.

clue.text: Supremo, at one, seen outside pub in American city

indicators.note: seen outside says the first pieces sit around the pub word

parts.note: C-in-C, commander-in-chief, is the supreme officer
taken as written
I is the Roman numeral for one
an inn is a pub

explanation.surface: A top boss, at one with everyone, is spotted outside a bar in a US city.
explanation.definitionFit: Cincinnati is a city in Ohio, United States.

clue.text: Like some frequencies, perhaps, we hear? On the contrary

definitions.text: Like some frequencies, perhaps, we hear? On the contrary

parts.words: Like some frequencies, perhaps, we hear? On the contrary
parts.note: some sound frequencies are too high or low for us to hear; the opposite of a word for what we can hear describes them

explanation.definitionFit: Ultrasonic and infrasonic frequencies lie outside human hearing, so they cannot be heard.

clue.text: Enchanting female left out of social group

indicators.note: out of says the left letter is removed from the group word

parts.note: a circle is a group of friends

explanation.surface: A charming woman finds herself excluded from her set of friends.
explanation.definitionFit: Circe is the enchantress of Greek myth who turned Odysseus's men into swine.

clue.text: Highly honoured person a small number call florid

parts.note: No. is the short form of number
to give someone a bell is to phone them
aureate describes an elaborate, ornate style

explanation.surface: A distinguished figure calls a few people in flowery language.
explanation.walkthrough: To give someone a bell is British slang for phoning them.
explanation.definitionFit: Winning a Nobel Prize is among the highest honours a scientist or writer can receive.

clue.text: Aesthetic style developed at 22

indicators.note: developed suggests the letters evolving into a new form

parts.note: taken as written
the answer to 22-down

explanation.surface: An artistic style grew up around a particular item.
explanation.walkthrough: 22 is the answer to 22-down, CREDO; with AT it is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Art Deco is the geometric design style of the 1920s and 1930s.

clue.text: Move slowly along Scottish island

definitions.meaning: to edge forward by small amounts
in Scots, an ... or innis is a small island

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means creep forward; the Scottish noun means a small island, as in Inchcolm.

clue.text: A man set out to become a composer

indicators.note: set out suggests the letters being laid out afresh

explanation.surface: A man departs on a journey to become a musician.
explanation.definitionFit: Bedřich Smetana was a Czech composer, best known for Má vlast.

clue.text: March past, occasion for japes

parts.note: not a parade but the day just after the third month ends, when pranks are played

explanation.definitionFit: The first of April is the traditional day for hoaxes and practical jokes.

clue.text: Deprive of hearing, becoming stiff and unemotional

parts.note: to rob is to deprive
otic means relating to the ear

explanation.surface: Losing one's hearing makes a person rigid and cold.
explanation.definitionFit: Robotic describes mechanical movement and an emotionless manner, like a machine.

clue.text: Athlete put in the shade — lighter than the opposition

definitions.text: Athlete put in the shade — lighter than the opposition

parts.words: Athlete put in the shade — lighter than the opposition
parts.note: a sportsman from one university, and a pale colour lighter than that of its rival university

explanation.walkthrough: A Blue is a sportsperson representing Oxford or Cambridge; Cambridge's light blue is paler than Oxford's dark blue.
explanation.definitionFit: The term names both a Cambridge sporting representative and the pale blue colour of that university.

clue.text: Novel market pilgrim progressed through

definitions.meaning: the fair in Bunyan's The Pilgrim's Progress that Christian passes through

explanation.definitionFit: Thackeray named his novel after the worldly fair in Bunyan's allegory.

clue.text: Girl, unaffected by setback, left record of events

indicators.note: unaffected by setback says the name reads the same backwards

parts.note: Anna is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl, undaunted by misfortune, left a diary.
explanation.definitionFit: An annal is a year's record of events; annals are historical records.

clue.text: Superior to a star in dance

parts.note: a boss is one's superior
a nova is a star that suddenly brightens

explanation.surface: Someone outranks a celebrity on the dance floor.
explanation.definitionFit: Bossa nova is a Brazilian dance and musical style related to samba.

clue.text: Final fling in children's game breaking things, unfortunately

indicators.note: breaking says the game word goes into the middle of the other letters
unfortunately suggests things going awry, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: tag is a chasing game played by children

explanation.surface: A last bit of fun as a playground game smashes things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfortunately' rearranges the letters and 'breaking' puts the game into them. A stag night is a British groom's party with friends before his wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: A stag night is a groom's last celebration as a single man, a final fling.

clue.text: Convoluted love repeatedly appears in this, possibly

indicators.note: convoluted means tangled, so the letters are rearranged
repeatedly means the love letter is taken twice

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A tangled romance keeps appearing in a TV drama.
explanation.walkthrough: 'this' points back to the clue itself: twisting love affairs are staple fare in such a show.
explanation.definitionFit: A soap opera is a serial drama famous for complicated romances.

clue.text: Poor competitor pulled out of final so rancorously

indicators.note: pulled out of says the letters are extracted from inside the phrase

explanation.surface: A weak contestant withdraws from a final very bitterly.
explanation.definitionFit: An also-ran is a loser in a race or contest, someone undistinguished.

clue.text: Artist joining bishops and one other religious leader

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop, doubled for the plural
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A painter joins some bishops and another faith's leader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'other' signals a leader of a different faith from the bishops.
explanation.definitionFit: A rabbi is a Jewish religious teacher and leader.

clue.text: Musical composition offered, excluding nothing?

annotationWithheld.why: Musical composition offered, excluding nothing? (7): BALLADE reads as BADE (offered) around ALL, but 'excluding nothing' must give ALL and also signal the container, one phrase doing two jobs

clue.text: Lively social whirl around new high-tech area

indicators.note: around says the rearranged letters go about the new letter
whirl suggests spinning the letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A busy round of parties surrounds a fresh tech hub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'whirl' signals the rearrangement and 'around' the wrapping; the surface's party scene hides that 'Lively' is fodder, not description.
explanation.definitionFit: Silicon Valley in California is the heartland of the technology industry.

clue.text: About to give an encore? Part of mass

parts.note: C stands for circa, about
giving an encore means performing again, to redo

explanation.surface: A singer is about to perform an extra piece, part of a mass.
explanation.definitionFit: The Credo, the creed, is one of the sung sections of the Mass.

clue.text: Abnormality in character produced by conflict and pressure

parts.note: war is armed conflict
P is the physics abbreviation for pressure

explanation.surface: Fighting and stress twist someone's personality.
explanation.definitionFit: A warp is a twist or perversion, as in a warped mind.

clue.text: Shorten a violin part

parts.note: the bridge supports a violin's strings

explanation.surface: Cut down a section of a violin piece.
explanation.definitionFit: To abridge a text is to shorten it.

clue.text: Small bomb nearly finished off a Caribbean island

indicators.note: nearly finished off says the last letter of the bomb word is cut

parts.note: a grenade is a small hand-thrown bomb

explanation.surface: A grenade almost wiped out an island in the West Indies.
explanation.definitionFit: Grenada is an island nation in the southern Caribbean.

clue.text: A small amount of heroin produced by plant

parts.note: pennywort is a plant with round leaves
H is slang for heroin

explanation.surface: A little heroin is extracted from a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A pennyworth is literally as much as a penny buys, hence a small amount.

clue.text: One likely to succeed, producing song in audition

indicators.note: in audition means as heard, so the song word is taken by its sound

parts.note: an air is a tune or song

explanation.surface: A singer at an audition is tipped for success.
explanation.definitionFit: An heir is the person in line to succeed to a title or estate.
